info.title: Ufin - A Wii U JF Client
info.author: antu2010
info.description: A native Jellyfin media client for Wii U
info.details:
Ufin is a native Jellyfin client for the Nintendo Wii U, bringing your Jellyfin libraries to the console with a custom Wii U interface.

Browse movies, TV shows and music. Ufin supports server-transcoded 720p30 H.264 video, seeking, pause/resume, watched states, resume playback, audio/subtitle selection and video quality settings.

Music features album and artist browsing, artwork, playlists, queues, shuffle, volume control and a TV music visualizer.

The GamePad supports touchscreen browsing, Off-TV movie playback and media remote controls while video plays on the TV. Ufin also supports the Wii U Pro Controller, Wii Remote, Nunchuk and Classic Controller.

The UI includes dark/light modes, custom colors and animated backgrounds.

Ufin is still in beta and has been tested extensively on real Wii U hardware.

AI disclaimer: Most of Ufin's code was AI-generated. The project author handled the architecture, features, design, integration, testing and real-hardware debugging.

changelog:
v1.3.0
Ufin v1.3 — A major update!

Ufin v1.3 brings a redesigned Material 3 Expressive experience, lyrics and synced lyrics, improved music library and playlist management, a full Up Next queue, and new GamePad controls features for movies.

it brings:

- Material 3 Expressive with customization and animations
- Plain and synchronized lyrics
- Subtitle and language selection before playing 4 
- Library sorting and playlist management
- Up Next queue with reordering and quick-add
- Four visualizer styles,
- Liquid Glass refraction improvements
- HTTPS support, including self-signed certificates
- Video quality change while playing a movie/episode
